new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors to Announce Second-Quarter 2026 Financial Results on July 29
new_today_news.summary: Clean Harbors (NYSE: CLH) announced it will release Q2 2026 financial results after market close on July 29, 2026, with a conference call on the same day at 9:00 a.m. ET featuring co-CEOs and CFO to discuss financial results, business outlook and growth strategy.

new_today_news.headline: Waste Connections to Develop Regional PFAS Treatment Hub at Anson Landfill
new_today_news.summary: Chambers Development of North Carolina (Waste Connections company) announced plans to develop a regional PFAS treatment system at Anson Landfill in Polkton, North Carolina. The system will treat landfill leachate onsite using the LEEF System®, expected to come online by end of 2026, treating up to 50,000 gallons per day.
